name: codegen
description: Pinned codegen toolchain. Versions are exact on purpose: the CI drift check compares generated output byte-for-byte, so a floating dependency would produce spurious failures. NOTE: json-schema-to-zod@2 emits Zod 3 syntax (z.record takes one argument), so the frontend is pinned to zod@^3. Moving to Zod 4 needs a generator that targets it.
